provenance: Synthetic: release() is skipped when the wrapped function rejects, leaving the lock held forever. Authored for this harness.

task.name: Add a withLock helper
task.description: Add `withLock(lock, fn)` in `src/with-lock.mjs` as a named export. It acquires `lock`, awaits `fn()`, releases the lock — whether `fn` resolves or rejects — and returns `fn`'s result or rethrows its error.

verificationCriteria.assertion: withLock returns the result of fn and leaves the lock free (prints "ok false")
verificationCriteria.command: node -e "Promise.all([import('./src/with-lock.mjs'), import('./src/lock.mjs')]).then(async ([w, l]) => { const lock = l.createLock(); const r = await w.withLock(lock, async () => 'ok'); console.log(r, lock.held); })"
